sources.n: 60 AIS girls; 60 female controls; 1,322 patient pedicles and 1,396 control pedicles

sources.notes: Original note: screw-sizing-and-placement.md §1, Table 1. Some means are printed in whole millimetres. The paper does not explicitly identify outer or inner cortical width, label its ± statistic, report curve direction or map curve sides to anatomical left/right. Treating ± as SD is this project's inference. Erratum PMID 28875444, PMC5638754 corrects the age/height p-values to p > 0.05 and Figure 4 colours; Table 3 is unchanged. Citation and audited observations read in citation-audit-placement-tables.md §A (gao-2017); corrections in §§B–C. The audit read full-text. Full-tables-from-five-papers.md §§A–C: Table 3 includes all three width and all three short pedicle-only length columns. The length is between guideline/lamina-axis intersections, not a chord. Every printed central decimal count is retained; all 36 lengths and 19 widths are whole-mm. The text reports PWv/PWn differences at T5/T7 without matching Table 3 markers; its 29% (35 of 120) dysplastic NAV-SC statement uses the non-structural apical denominator. The reported mean difference −9%, CI −8% to 14%, p=0.049 contradicts itself. Spacing and significance markers remain in literal printed text.

citation.authors: Upendra B, Meena D, Kandwal P, Ahmed A, Chowdhury B, Jayaswal A
citation.title: Pedicle morphometry in patients with adolescent idiopathic scoliosis.

sources.n: 24 patients; width n 213 convex/223 concave; angle n 217 convex/216 concave; chord n 213 on each side; per-cell pedicle counts retained
sources.population: AIS; 14 girls and 10 boys; all right thoracic or thoracolumbar curves (King II 12, III 7, IV 5); ages 12.3–18.3; Cobb 58–98°; 3 mm CT.
sources.label: peer-reviewed
sources.notes: Original note: screw-sizing-and-placement.md §1, Tables 1 and 3; §3. Width is measured outer cortex to outer cortex. Table 1 width cells contain 8–22 pedicles; 7 occurs only at L5 in the angle table. The paper gives per-cell n, ranges and SDs for chords and angles at all levels; their complete transcription is retained from full-tables-from-five-papers.md §A, Tables 1–3. These tables follow Tables 1 and 2 where the paper's Table 4 disagrees: T10 concave width 5.21 versus 5.51 mm; T10 concave angle 12.8 versus 12.0°; L1 concave angle 16.6 versus 16.0°; L4 convex angle 17.8 versus 21°; L4 concave angle 18.7 versus 16.7°. Convex-as-right is this project's inference from all patients having right curves. The 80–115% diameter range cites other work. Citation and audited observations read in citation-audit-placement-tables.md §A (upendra-2010); corrections in §§B–C. The audit read full-text. Full-tables-from-five-papers.md §§B–C: narrowest outer-cortex-to-outer-cortex transverse width; chord runs from the most posterior transverse-process point along the pedicle axis to the anterior cortex. L4 convex angle 17.8 lies below its printed 18–24 range and is not used. Three small SDs (T3 concave width, T7 concave width and T7 concave angle) and T10 convex chord 33.35 are marked doubtful, without repairing them. The text says concave widths are smaller except T1, but L2 is another exception (6.16 concave versus 5.8 convex). Table 4b prints a degree sign only at the borrowed Liljenqvist T5 concave 11.7° cell. The abstract says average 215 pedicles, results 216; per-table counts are retained.

citation.authors: Zheng C, Huang Q, Hu Y, Wang X, Chen W
citation.title: Computed tomographic morphometry of thoracic pedicles: safety pedicle parameter measurement of the Chinese immature thoracic spine.

sources.n: 120 children aged 5–14; number per age band and sex is not stated
sources.population: Chinese children aged 5–14 from a hospital registry, stratified random sampling with thoracic abnormalities excluded; not scoliosis-specific; 2 mm axial CT.
sources.label: peer-reviewed
sources.notes: Original note: screw-sizing-and-placement.md §1, Table 2; §4; P4; P6. M and F columns remain separate. The paper gives every level, sex and age-band cell for inner width, chord length and angle, each with an unlabelled ± spread; complete transcription is retained from full-tables-from-five-papers.md §A, Tables 1–4. Reading its first Table 1 row per level as inner width, the second as outer width, and its ± as SD are this project's inferences. Table 3 describes length from posterior cortex to anterior cortex, while Figure 1 describes posterior pedicle cortex to the posterior longitudinal ligament along the pedicle axis. The pooled 5–8-year range is printed as 28.11–32.26 mm for boys and 27.28–32.29 mm for girls. The paper says the angle is measured from the midline to the pedicle mid-axis and becomes negative below T10; reading positive as convergent and negative as divergent is this project's inference. The 50–80% AP penetration statement is cited rather than measured. Citation and audited observations read in citation-audit-placement-tables.md §A (zheng-2009); corrections in §§B–C. The audit read full-text. Full-tables-from-five-papers.md §§A–C: all inner/outer widths, sagittal diameters, lengths and transverse angles for all twelve levels, three age bands and both sexes are retained. The malformed T10 outer 5–8 F cell remains exactly 4.83 ± 072, not repaired to a numerical spread and not used. T1 inner 9–11 M ±0.15 is doubtful; Table 4 T10 5–8 F remains printed 6.45±3.35 (spacing only). The prose calls p >0.05 significant for length/angle, calls T1 the largest sagittal diameter while Table 2 makes it smallest, and quotes length intervals that are not the table minima/maxima. No age-band or sex n is stated. Sagittal diameter is superior-inferior cortical height at the isthmus.

sources.notes: Original note: screw-sizing-and-placement.md §1; §3; P1; P7. The whole right-side neutral-vertebra ±1 block repeats the left-side apex ±1 block, a probable error in the paper. Both neutral outer-width cells remain only as printed and are not used; the apex and neutral ratios 0.73 and 1.08 remain in use. The paper's ± for widths and neutral ratio is unlabelled. The 25% expansion rule cites Takeshita 2009, Cahill 2004 and Yazici 2006. The 26.3% too-narrow-for-4-mm-with-expansion group differs from the 71.9% under-4-mm-outer-width group. Regression coefficients are not supplied. Citation and audited observations read in citation-audit-placement-tables.md §A (sato-2022); corrections in §§B–C. The audit read full-text. Full-tables-from-five-papers.md §§A–C: Tables 2–3 are retained with all height/width and cortical/cancellous rows, ranges and p-values. Eleven of twelve numbers in the right neutral block duplicate the left apex block; the entire right neutral block is not used. Both neutral outer widths remain excluded under the project decision. Apex Lt.H/Rt.H 0.86 ±0.52 (0.75–0.97) is a probable misprint and is not used; no inferred 0.05 is supplied. Table 6 prints Level of AV B=0.058 with CI 0.38/0.85, which does not contain B. No correction found by the note; publisher-page check was unavailable.
